      - Therefore, no orphans.

        - type: "payment" -> payment line
        - type: "refund" -> refund line
    - Rule 13: a refund line is never an orphan. So we only consider payment lines that are not linked to any order.

    We have one payment line (E1000000010001) and it is linked -> so orphans is empty.
